# Ci

KnotGate's CI configuration. `Tools/_KG/Ci/modules.yml` points Wolfgate's `Tools/_WG/Ci/modules.py` at the
`_KG` layer (prefix, marker, the closed migrations folder, the Wolfgate `fork_point`). CI picks it up through the
repository variable `MODULES_LAYER_CONFIG`; publishing uses Wolfgate's `publish.yml` with `CDN_FORK_ID` = `knotgate`.
